# The documentation corpus map

One row per area folder of `vendor/ServiceNowDocs/markdown/`, made from the whole corpus at pin `c10276e953456835cdbb1f3a60d58ae1980be353`: the area's title, its pages, and its three most frequent `product:` values. Every row is here on any install; the banner's `Docs on disk:` line says which areas this checkout has.

How to find a page:
- Grep `markdown/*/index.md`: one line per page, with its title, its path and a summary.
- Read a URL's `/australia/<area>/…` as `markdown/<area>/…`.
- Grep `^product: <name>` in page frontmatter.
- Prefer a product's own area to `delta-*` and release notes.
